t: Germany in Fall is Epic! [BEST Places to Visit]
s: January 9, 2024 - Fall is one of the best times of year to visit Berlin, the capital of Germany. The weather’s not as good as in summer, but the shorter days mean you have longer evenings enjoying the city’s nightlife. It’s also considerably warmer than during the winter, when Berlin can get bitterly cold. Berlin normally gets a good share of fall colors. It has plenty of parks which are great for autumn walks, including the Tiergarten, just to the west of the Brandenburg Gate.
